title: Ashbury Rewards Points Purchase Terms Schedule
content:
Ashbury Rewards members may buy points for their own account. This schedule sets, for every tier, the annual purchase cap, the price of 1000 points before tax, the purchase increment, the minimum age of the account, and whether purchased points can be refunded.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Maximum points bought per calendar year | Price of 1000 points before tax (USD) | Points are bought in multiples of | Minimum calendar days since enrolment before buying | Purchased points refundable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 100000 | 12.50 | 1000 | 30 | No |

The terms are identical at all six tiers.

## Worked figure (hypothetical order)

At the schedule price, 8000 points cost 8000 divided by 1000, multiplied by 12.50 US dollars, which is 100.00 US dollars before tax. A quantity of 8500 points is not a multiple of 1000 and is not a purchasable quantity.

## Points of judgement

- **Increment.** Quantities are whole multiples of 1000 points.
- **Refunds.** At every tier purchased points are not refundable.
